lead.headline: QM SURGES TO #1 ON GITHUB
lead.deck: YC-Software's QM project is rapidly gaining traction as the fastest-growing repository on GitHub, with a staggering 2,689 new stars in the last day alone
lead.body: The project, which has now accumulated 5,288 total stars, is a multiplayer agent harness designed to facilitate collaborative work among teams. Its sudden surge in popularity suggests that it may be addressing a pressing need in the industry, possibly by streamlining workflows, enhancing productivity, or providing a more efficient way to manage complex projects. As more developers and organizations become aware of its capabilities, it is likely that QM will continue to attract attention and users, potentially leading to significant advancements in the field of collaborative work
